# Qualisys

> > Qualisys provides advanced motion capture technology and systems for biomechanical analysis, sports research, and entertainment applications.

Qualisys is a leading provider of precision motion capture solutions used in biomechanics, gait analysis, sports performance, and animation. The company serves research institutions, sports organizations, and entertainment studios worldwide with cutting-edge tracking technology.

## Key Topics

- Motion capture technology
- Biomechanical analysis
- Gait analysis
- Sports research
- Human biomechanics
- Entertainment animation
- Engineering solutions
- 3D tracking systems
- Movement analysis
- Performance capture
- Clinical biomechanics
- Research instrumentation
- IPO and investor relations
